name: Ethical & Professional Standards
description: The bedrock of the CFA program. Code of Ethics, Standards of Professional Conduct, GIPS. Heavy in scenario-based questions where the right answer comes from applying principles to nuance.
draftFlag: LOS list authored from training knowledge; verify against current CFA Institute Level 1 syllabus.

modules.name: Code of Ethics & Standards of Professional Conduct

lessons.name: Code of Ethics & Standards of Professional Conduct

los.statement: describe the structure of the CFA Institute Professional Conduct Program and the process for the enforcement of the Code and Standards
identify the six components of the Code of Ethics and the seven Standards of Professional Conduct
explain the ethical responsibilities required by the Code and Standards, including the sub-sections of each Standard

demonstrate the application of the Code and Standards to situations involving Standard I: Professionalism (Knowledge of the Law, Independence and Objectivity, Misrepresentation, Misconduct, Competence)
recommend practices and procedures designed to prevent violations of Standard I

lessons.name: Standard II: Integrity of Capital Markets

los.statement: demonstrate the application of the Code and Standards to situations involving Standard II: Integrity of Capital Markets (Material Nonpublic Information, Market Manipulation)
recommend practices and procedures designed to prevent violations of Standard II

demonstrate the application of the Code and Standards to situations involving Standard III: Duties to Clients (Loyalty, Prudence, and Care; Fair Dealing; Suitability; Performance Presentation; Preservation of Confidentiality)
recommend practices and procedures designed to prevent violations of Standard III
demonstrate the application of the Code and Standards to situations involving Standard IV: Duties to Employers (Loyalty, Additional Compensation Arrangements, Responsibilities of Supervisors)
recommend practices and procedures designed to prevent violations of Standard IV

lessons.name: Standard V: Investment Analysis, Recommendations & Actions

los.statement: demonstrate the application of the Code and Standards to situations involving Standard V: Investment Analysis, Recommendations, and Actions (Diligence and Reasonable Basis, Communication with Clients and Prospective Clients, Record Retention)
recommend practices and procedures designed to prevent violations of Standard V
demonstrate the application of the Code and Standards to situations involving Standard VI: Conflicts of Interest (Avoid or Disclose Conflicts, Priority of Transactions, Referral Fees)
recommend practices and procedures designed to prevent violations of Standard VI

lessons.name: Standard VII: Responsibilities as a CFA Member/Candidate

los.statement: demonstrate the application of the Code and Standards to situations involving Standard VII: Responsibilities as a CFA Institute Member or CFA Candidate (Conduct as Participants in CFA Institute Programs, Reference to CFA Institute, the CFA Designation, and the CFA Program)
recommend practices and procedures designed to prevent violations of Standard VII

modules.name: Introduction to the Global Investment Performance Standards (GIPS)

los.statement: explain why the GIPS standards were created, what parties the GIPS standards apply to and who is served by the standards
explain the construction and purpose of composites in performance reporting
explain the requirements for verification
evaluate practices, policies, and conduct relative to the CFA Institute Code of Ethics and Standards of Professional Conduct
explain how the practices, policies, and conduct does or does not violate the CFA Institute Code of Ethics and Standards of Professional Conduct
